title: Granting a plot of land to the Ceylon College of Physicians on long term lease basis
decision_details: - A plot of land in extent of 30 perches located in Welikada, Rajagiriya has been granted to the Ceylon College of Physicians on long-term lease basis for a period of 30 years with effect from 1999‑05‑13 at an annual lease rent of 0.5% of the market value as assessed by the Chief Government Valuer. The said lease period is scheduled to expire in 2029. The institute has requested to obtain the said land again on a long-term lease basis, so that a significant investment can be made and the head office of the said institute which has been erected and is currently in a dilapidated condition can be renovated. At the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑06‑24, approval has been granted to lease the said plot of land for a period of 50 years, on the basis of collecting the annual lease rent as determined by the Chief Government Valuer. However, a request has been made to grant the relevant land on long-term lease basis at a concessional annual rent as per the provisions of the lease agreement currently in force, stating that the said institute is a non-profit making institution established solely for the purpose of promoting research in the advancement of medical knowledge, and therefore it is not in a position to pay a high rental amount. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to lease the relevant land to the Ceylon College of Physicians for a period of 50 years based on the provisions of the Agreement which is currently in force, was approved by the Cabinet.
